kind: Pinned WCN7860 hw2.0 WLAN firmware identities for ath12k; not a redistribution license
source: modem_a FAT image, image/peach directory, renamed to the ath12k request names: amss20.bin -> amss.bin, phy_ucode20.elf -> m3.bin, aux_ucode20.elf -> aux_ucode.bin, regdb_xiaomi.bin -> regdb.bin, qdss_trace_config_v2.cfg -> qdss.cfg, bd_p81.elf -> board.bin
selection: board.bin is the stock China-region API 1 board file (bd_p81.elf) used as the fallback when no board-2.bin is present; qdss.cfg is only read by kernels carrying the QDSS download patches. The firmware reports an all-zero MAC address on this unit; the address comes from the per-device persist data at build time (never included here).
